Karan Singh Advocates for Jammu and Kashmir Statehood Restoration

Veteran leader Karan Singh has urged the restoration of statehood to Jammu and Kashmir, stating that the people should not have to plead for it. He emphasized the importance of 'Kashmiriyat,' a concept he described as the soul of coexistence and humanity, urging that religious considerations should be secondary. Singh recalled a promise made by the Centre regarding statehood restoration and expressed his belief in its fulfillment.
